concerns.text: T002 requires the loader to 'fail loudly (raise) if ... the attached dataset's provenance does not name the origin of hardness values', but the active contract `contracts/materials_dataset.schema.yaml` has NO provenance field and the data model defines none. The gate has no schema-enforced input to check, so an implementer cannot deterministically decide what counts as 'naming the origin'. Either add a provenance/metadata field to the dataset contract (and a fixture carrying it) or specify the exact sidecar file/format the gate reads.

T008's verification runs 'on the fixture checkpoints', but no task explicitly produces fixture checkpoints: T006's fixture run does not state it saves checkpoints under `outputs/`, and T007 is gated. Add an explicit statement that the T006 code-validation run saves fold checkpoints (with their path) so T008's unit tests have a deterministic input.

T005 bundles three deliverables (CompositionGNN model, RF baseline, training loop with runtime guard) into one task — too coarse for deterministic execution. Split into model definitions, training loop, and runtime guard (the atomizer will handle this, but flagging).

T011's 're-run one fold under 3 pinned seeds and report the spread of R²' is only executable when the gated scientific run has happened; when gated, the task does not say whether the seed-stability check runs on the fixture (labeled code-validation-only) or is skipped. Specify the gated fallback so verification is deterministic either way.

T014's verification 'a clean re-run reproduces byte-identical metrics given the pinned seed' is undefined when the study is gated (no metrics JSON exists). Add the gated branch: re-run reproduces the fixture code-validation outputs / test pass, and the gap is recorded.
